systems.platform: DHIS2 with chatbot interface for community health workers

MWI.note: The only AI named is a chatbot inside the health sector's community system, which is sector AI.

facts.fact: The DHIS2 profile says the Ministry of Health has used DHIS2 as its Health Management Information System since 2012, owned and maintained by the ministry with technical support from HISP UNIMA.
The DHIS2 profile says the Ministry of Health has used DHIS2 since 2012 as its HMIS, the main data collection tool and national repository for health data covering more than 60 health programs.

MWI.note: Nothing on national ID use by other registers.
